topic_name: Is maith liom / Ní maith liom…

core_phrases.irish: Is maith liom spraoi a bheith agam
core_phrases.pronunciation_tip: Is ma-ha lum spree ah veh ah-gum

core_phrases.irish: Ní maith liom an aimsir fhuar
core_phrases.english: I don't like the cold weather
core_phrases.pronunciation_tip: Nee ma-ha lum on am-sir oo-ar

grammar_rule.title: Using 'Is maith liom' and 'Ní maith liom'
grammar_rule.explanation: Use 'Is maith liom' to express likes and 'Ní maith liom' to express dislikes. Followed by the object of the liking/disliking.
examples: Ní maith liom an aimsir fhuar

pronunciation_notes: Pay attention to the slender 'mh' sound in 'maith'
Practice the rhythm of the phrases

mini_task.instruction: Talk about your likes and dislikes. Use 'Is maith liom' and 'Ní maith liom' in your sentences.
